SPACEMED is the Erasmus Mundus master in physiology and medicine of humans in space, coordinated from Caen with European space-medicine partners. The 2027 intake campaign opened on 21 October 2026 and closes on 21 January 2027 at 23:59 CET, with admissions announced in early April.

Programme Highlights

  • First-of-its-kind space medicine Erasmus Mundus
  • Three-month window: 21 October 2026 – 21 January 2027 (23:59 CET)
  • Video motivation statement among the required documents
  • Graduates target space agencies, aerospace medicine and extreme-environment research

Who Should Apply

Medicine, physiology, biology and biomedical science graduates are the core audience; a one-minute English video explaining motivation is part of the file.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Create an account on the SPACEMED platform, select the EMJM SpaceMed campaign, and upload the full document set before 21 January 2027. Key deadline information: 21 January 2027 (23:59 CET); campaign opened 21 October 2026, admission letters by early April 2027.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About SPACEMED Consortium

The SPACEMED consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in the physiology and medicine of humans in space, coordinated from France with European space-research partners.

Official website: https://space-med.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 21 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
